name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost is the ultimate productivity toolkit for WordPress content creators. It seamlessly integrates into the Classic Editor (TinyMCE), providing the essential writing and SEO tools you need without leaving the editing screen.

Stop installing multiple plugins for single features. DominoPost combines a robust Table of Contents, a site-wide Broken Link Checker, intelligent Text Formatting, and analysis tools into one lightweight, performance-optimized package.

🚀 Key Features

  • ⚡ Automatic Table of Contents (TOC): Generate informative and SEO-friendly TOCs with 4 customizable styles (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed). Includes a live visual preview in settings.
  • 🕵️‍♂️ Broken Link Scanner: Find and fix 404 errors across your entire site from a dedicated dashboard. Edit or unlink broken URLs instantly without opening posts.
  • 📝 Title Case Converter: Fix capitalization in headings and sentences with a single click in the editor toolbar.
  • ⏱️ Estimated Reading Time: Show readers exactly how long your content takes to read.
  • 📋 One-Click Copy Code: Enhance your technical tutorials with copy-to-clipboard buttons for code blocks.
  • ⬇️ CTA Buttons: Easily insert call-to-action buttons to boost conversions.

Why Use DominoPost?

  1. Improve SEO: A proper Table of Contents and fixing broken links are two of the most impactful on-page SEO improvements you can make.
  2. Save Time: No more manual HTML editing for TOCs or hunting for correct capitalization.
  3. Better User Experience: Helpful navigation and error-free links keep readers engaged longer.

Usage Examples

Example 1: Keeping Content Fresh with Update Reminders

You’re maintaining a “WordPress Tutorial” that needs quarterly updates:

  1. Write your comprehensive tutorial
  2. In the Update Reminder meta box, set next review to 90 days from now
  3. Publish your post
  4. After 90 days, see dashboard notification: “Content needs update: WordPress Tutorial”
  5. Click Notified to mark as updated (sets next reminder to 90 days)
  6. Or click Remind me 2 days later if you need more time

Result: Your content stays fresh with minimal effort!

Example 2: Related Posts for Better Engagement

You have several posts about “WordPress SEO”:

Automatic Method:
1. Go to DominoPost → Settings
2. Enable “Related Posts”
3. Set count to 6 posts
4. Choose matching by “Tags”
5. Save settings

Manual Method (for specific posts):
1. Edit a post
2. Find Related Posts meta box
3. Check 3-5 related articles
4. Save post

Result: At the end of each SEO-related post, readers see a numbered list of related articles, keeping them engaged longer.

Example 3: Professional Code Snippets

You’re sharing PHP code examples:

  1. Select your code in the editor
  2. Click the “Copy Code” button
  3. Enter a title like “functions.php code”
  4. Choose your theme color
  5. Insert

Result: Beautiful, syntax-highlighted code block with a one-click copy button.

Example 4: Table of Contents for Long Articles

You’re writing a comprehensive guide with multiple sections:

  1. Write your article with H2 and H3 headings
  2. Click the TOC button in toolbar
  3. Select which headings to include
  4. Choose a style (Bullets/Numbers/Minimal/Boxed)
  5. Insert at top of content
  6. Publish

Result: Readers get a clickable table of contents with smooth scrolling to sections.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
* Documentation: https://dominopress.com/terms-of-service
* Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/dominopost-advanced-post-editor

Credits

Developed by DominoPress – Making WordPress editing better.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dominopost-advanced-post-editor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to DominoPost Settings to configure your Table of Contents and run your first Broken Link Scan.
  4. Open any post in the Classic Editor to see the new toolbar buttons!
sections.faq:
When the date arrives, you’ll see a notification on your Dashboard with two buttons:
– Notified – Marks the post as updated and sets the next reminder
– Remind me 2 days later – Hides the notification for 2 days

Can I mark some content as evergreen?

Yes! In the Update Reminder meta box, check “Mark as Evergreen” to disable reminders for specific posts that don’t need regular updates.

How do I manually select Related Posts?

  1. Edit any post
  2. Find the Related Posts meta box in the right sidebar
  3. Check the posts you want to feature
  4. Save the post

If you don’t select any, the plugin will automatically show related posts based on tags/categories.

Does this work with Gutenberg?

DominoPost uses the Classic Editor for a streamlined, distraction-free writing experience. The Classic Editor is automatically enabled when you activate DominoPost.

Will this slow down my site?

No! DominoPost is optimized for performance:
* Frontend CSS/JS only loads when needed
* Minimal database queries
* Efficient algorithms
* No impact on page load times

Can I disable specific features?

Yes! Each feature can be toggled on/off in the settings. You have complete control over which tools you use.
